name: Shandong Hi-Speed Road and Bridge Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Hi-Speed Road and Bridge Group Co., Ltd. is a major player in the construction and engineering sector, undertaking projects both within China and internationally. Its extensive capabilities cover a wide range of infrastructure development, including the construction of highways, railways, bridges, tunnels, and highway pavement and traffic systems. The company also specializes in general contracting, residential building, water conservancy and hydropower initiatives, port and waterway infrastructure, and steel structure fabrication, alongside municipal public works. Established in 1948 and headquartered in Jinan, China, the firm officially adopted its present name, Shandong Hi-Speed Road and Bridge Group Co., Ltd., in January 2021, having previously operated as Shandong Hi-Speed Road & Bridge Co., Ltd. The company operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Hi-speed Group Co.,Ltd.
